run_notes: Full pass ran in two sessions. Session A recorded rows 1-79 and was interrupted at case 79 by a Windows console cp1252 UnicodeEncodeError while printing a long judge completion (exit 1); no row was lost or corrupted. Session B (guardrail_runner 1.0.1, UTF-8 console fix) resumed by skipping the 79 rows whose id+input_sha256 matched and appended rows 80-221. started_at/finished_at/wall_seconds below describe the completing session (142 cases).
A plain rerun after completion is a no-op: 0 pending, guardrail.jsonl and meta.json byte-unchanged (221 rows, unique ids, one per input).

NeMo Guardrails 0.24.1 overrides the model parameters temperatures/max_tokens for the self-check call with config.lowest_temperature and the task max_tokens default (1024). config.yml therefore pins lowest_temperature: 0.0 (0.24.1 default is 0.001) so the judge is greedy; the captured request body is model=local, temperature=0.0, seed=42, max_tokens=1024 for the judge call, and temperature=0.0, seed=42, max_tokens=16 for the dialog generation call. Judge outputs can therefore be long 'No.***Reasoning***' completions; NeMo's is_content_safe parser reads the first two words so all 221 decisions parsed as Yes/No (0 unparseable).
Rows 1-79 were produced by runner 1.0.0 and rows 80-221 by 1.0.1; the only difference is progress-log encoding (data row schema, config and prompts unchanged).
